rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a person fleeing persecution, war, disaster, or other danger, especially across a border.

example.english: After the war broke out, one refugee had to leave their home.
example.traditional: 戰爭爆發之後，有個難民要離開自己嘅家鄉。
example.jyutping: zin3 zang1 baau3 faat3 zi1 hau6 jau5 go3 naan6 man4 jiu3 lei4 hoi1 zi6 gei2 ge3 gaa1 hoeng1
